dakar2026.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — International Visitors for Dakar 2026
dakar2026.faq1Q: When should I secure airport transfers and accommodation?
dakar2026.faq1A: Due to unprecedented visitor influx across Dakar and Diamniadio, securing your logistics during the first half of 2026 is strongly recommended.
dakar2026.faq2Q: Do I need a visa to enter Senegal?
dakar2026.faq2A: Citizens of ECOWAS, the European Union, and several other nationalities do not require an entry visa for stays up to 90 days with a valid passport. Our advisors can verify the current requirements for your specific nationality.
